newsitem.title: UK: Weather shuts Black Sea Novorossiisk, Odessa ports.
newsitem.headline: Weather shuts Black Sea Novorossiisk, Odessa ports.

text.p: Russia's leading oil export terminal at Novorossiisk on the Black Sea was closed early on Thursday due to bad weather, shipping sources said.
"The port has been closed from 0100 (local time) to now due to strong winds and swell," one source said.
Winds as strong as force eight and waves up to three metres high were preventing crude and oil product tankers from berthing.
Two vessels were alongside but a further five crude tankers and four product carriers were waiting at anchor outside the 650,000 barrels per day terminal, the source said.
The port at Odessa in Ukraine was also closed but Russia's Tuapse was open, as was the Baltic terminal at Ventspils, the source added.
